statement: NVIDIA, Google and Emerald AI launched the AI Energy Management Alliance (AEMA) on 2026-09-16 to set standards for grid-flexible data centers and faster interconnection pathways; no capacity or timing figures were stated.
why: Grid interconnection is a binding long-lead constraint on new AI data-center capacity; an industry standard for flexible, grid-enhancing sites could shorten the approval queue for compliant facilities and let ordered accelerators be installed sooner.

impact.mechanism: Standardized response-speed, duration and ride-through metrics give utilities and grid operators a basis to grant faster interconnection to compliant sites, easing the power bottleneck that gates GPU deployment.

evidence.excerpt: establishes standards for ride-through capabilities, curtailment obligations, and faster interconnection pathways for compliant facilities

confidence.basis: Official NVIDIA announcement of the alliance, but wholly qualitative - the document states no numeric figures for interconnection-time reduction or MW/GW capacity.
